create_conway_graph: create a jraph GraphsTuple representing Conway's game of life grid with a glider pattern
run_conway_mlp: run the MLP function that implements Conway's game of life rules on node input vectors
display_graph: display a jraph GraphsTuple as an ASCII grid showing alive and dead cells
build_conway_network: build a Haiku-transformed jraph InteractionNetwork to simulate Conway's game of life
test_conway_simulation: test the full Conway's game of life simulation loop with JIT compilation and graph updates
